links.outcome: Effect of outdated or contradictory retrieved PubMed abstracts on RAG answer accuracy and consistency
links.effect: Contradictions between highly similar retrieved abstracts degraded performance, causing inconsistencies and reduced factual accuracy in model answers. No numbers are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Our findings show that contradictions between highly similar abstracts do, in fact, degrade performance, leading to inconsistencies and reduced factual accuracy in model answers.

unlisted_practices: contradiction-aware filtering of retrieved documents in medical RAG

screen.reason: Evaluates the robustness and accuracy of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) when provided with contradictory or temporally outdated context for medical QA benchmarks.
